candidates.angle: sakhya, friendship, reveals a bond Arjuna fears he broke
pranidhaya, placing down, shows how low Arjuna falls
pranama, bowing down, is a physical act of surrender

angle_en: Sakhya: the bond of friendship Arjuna fears breaking
angle_hi: सख्युः: मित्रता का वह रिश्ता जिससे अर्जुन डरते हैं कि वह टूट गया है

en.intro: Arjuna has just seen the universe inside Krishna's body and now begs for mercy. Listen for the three relationships he uses to ask for forgiveness.
en.notice: The word sakhya means of a friend, and Arjuna places his body down to plead. He asks Krishna to forgive him as a friend forgives a friend, as a father forgives a son, and as a lover forgives a beloved, revealing the deep personal bond Arjuna fears he has broken.
en.next: Arjuna admits his mind is filled with fear, and he asks to see Krishna's gentle form once more.
en.meaning: Therefore, bowing down my body, I seek to please You, the worthy Lord of praise. Like a father bearing a son’s fault, a friend bearing a friend’s, or a lover bearing a beloved’s, You should forgive what I have done.

hi.intro: अर्जुन ने अभी-अभी कृष्ण के शरीर में ब्रह्मांड देखा है और अब वे क्षमा मांगते हैं। सुनिए, वे क्षमा मांगने के लिए किन तीन रिश्तों का उपयोग करते हैं।
hi.meaning: इसलिए शरीर से गिरकर मैं स्तुति के योग्य ईश्वर को प्रणाम करके प्रसन्न करना चाहता हूँ। जैसे पिता पुत्र के, मित्र मित्र के और प्रिय पुरुष प्रिया के अपमान को सह लेते हैं, वैसे ही हे देव, आप मेरे द्वारा किया गया अपमान सहने में समर्थ हैं।
hi.notice: सख्युः शब्द का अर्थ है मित्र का, और अर्जुन अपना शरीर नीचे रखकर विनती करते हैं। वे कृष्ण से पुत्र को पिता, मित्र को मित्र और प्रेमी को प्रेमिका की तरह क्षमा करने को कहते हैं, जो उस गहरे रिश्ते को दर्शाता है जिसे अर्जुन टूटने से डरते हैं।
hi.next: अर्जुन स्वीकार करते हैं कि उनका मन भय से भर गया है, और वे फिर से कृष्ण का शांत रूप देखने की विनती करते हैं।

en.intro: Arjuna has just seen the universe inside Krishna's body and now begs for mercy. Listen for the three relationships he uses to ask for forgiveness.
en.body: Therefore, bowing down my body, I seek to please You, the worthy Lord of praise. Like a father bearing a son’s fault, a friend bearing a friend’s, or a lover bearing a beloved’s, You should forgive what I have done. The word sakhya means of a friend, and Arjuna places his body down to plead. He asks Krishna to forgive him as a friend forgives a friend, as a father forgives a son, and as a lover forgives a beloved, revealing the deep personal bond Arjuna fears he has broken. Arjuna admits his mind is filled with fear, and he asks to see Krishna's gentle form once more.

issues: meaning_changed: "पति पत्नीके अपमान को सह लेता है" (The Sanskrit uses 'priyaḥ priyāyāḥ' (a beloved of a beloved/lover of a lover), which translates to a lover bearing the faults of a beloved. The Hindi translation incorrectly uses 'pati' (husband) and 'patni' (wife), changing the meaning from a lover to a spouse.)

unsupported: "अर्जुन अपने शरीर को नीचे रखकर विनती करते हैं" (The word meanings provided for the Sanskrit verse only list 'pranidhāya' as 'placing down' (likely the body), but the source text itself does not explicitly mention placing the body down as a physical action. The English translation says 'bowing down my body', but the Hindi translation's specific claim about 'placing down' (नीचे रखकर) is not explicitly supported by the source text provided.)
